purpose: Two same-template bound factories on the same Leaf receiver create equivalent fresh Generators at one private Mid method site. The selected Generator closes while its sibling stays fresh; both borrowed factories and their Capture retire first, then Maker retires after the final fresh sibling.
source:
<?php
class Capture79A {
    public function __destruct() { echo 'CAPTURE|'; }
}
class Base79A {
    public function __destruct() { echo 'MAKER|'; }
}
class Mid79A extends Base79A {
    private function body() {
        global $weakMaker;
        echo 'BODY|', (int) ($this === $weakMaker->get()), '|',
             (int) (__CLASS__ === 'Mid79A'), '|',
             (int) (static::class === 'Leaf79A'), '|';
        try {
            yield 79;
        } finally {
            echo 'FIN|';
        }
    }
}
class Leaf79A extends Mid79A {
    public function body() { echo 'BAD-BODY|'; yield 0; }
}
$maker = new Leaf79A();
$capture = new Capture79A();
$weakMaker = WeakReference::create($maker);
$weakCapture = WeakReference::create($capture);
$template = function () use ($capture) {
    echo 'CALL|';
    return $this->body();
};
$factory = $template->bindTo($maker, Mid79A::class);
$sibling = $template->bindTo($maker, Mid79A::class);
$weakFactory = WeakReference::create($factory);
$weakSibling = WeakReference::create($sibling);
unset($template, $capture);
$g = $factory();
$other = $sibling();
unset($factory, $sibling, $maker);
echo 'FRESH|', (int) ($weakFactory->get() === null), '|',
     (int) ($weakSibling->get() === null), '|',
     (int) ($weakCapture->get() === null), '|',
     (int) ($weakMaker->get() instanceof Leaf79A), '|';
echo 'VALUE|', (int) ($g->current() === 79), '|';
unset($g);
echo 'AFTER-A|', (int) ($weakMaker->get() instanceof Leaf79A), '|';
unset($other);
echo 'AFTER-B|', (int) ($weakMaker->get() === null), '|';
unset($weakMaker, $weakCapture, $weakFactory, $weakSibling);
echo 'E';

<?php
class Base79B {
    public function body() {
        global $weakFactoryThis, $weakTarget;
        echo 'BODY|', (int) ($this === $weakTarget->get()), '|',
             (int) ($this !== $weakFactoryThis->get()), '|',
             (int) (__CLASS__ === 'Base79B'), '|',
             (int) (static::class === 'Leaf79B'), '|';
        yield 79;
        return 80;
    }
}
class Leaf79B extends Base79B {}
$factoryThis = new Leaf79B();
$target = new Leaf79B();
$weakFactoryThis = WeakReference::create($factoryThis);
$weakTarget = WeakReference::create($target);
$template = function ($other) {
    echo 'CALL|';
    return $other->body();
};
$factory = $template->bindTo($factoryThis, Base79B::class);
$g = $factory($target);
unset($template, $factory, $factoryThis, $target);
echo 'FRESH|', (int) ($weakFactoryThis->get() === null), '|',
     (int) ($weakTarget->get() instanceof Leaf79B), '|';
echo 'VALUE|', (int) ($g->current() === 79), '|';
$g->next();
echo 'RETURN|', (int) ($g->getReturn() === 80), '|',
     (int) ($weakTarget->get() === null), '|';
unset($g, $weakFactoryThis, $weakTarget);
echo 'E';

purpose: Temporary Closure::call invokes nullsafe protected METHOD Generator; fresh Fiber abort runs finally and releases its real receiver.
source:
<?php
class Base79C {
    protected function body() {
        global $weakMaker;
        echo 'BODY|', (int) ($this === $weakMaker->get()), '|';
        try {
            Fiber::suspend('park79');
            yield 79;
            echo 'BAD-BODY|';
        } finally {
            echo 'FIN|';
        }
    }
}
class Leaf79C extends Base79C {}
$maker = new Leaf79C();
$weakMaker = WeakReference::create($maker);
$factory = function () {
    echo 'CALL|';
    return $this?->body();
};
$g = $factory->call($maker);
unset($factory, $maker);
echo 'FRESH|', (int) ($weakMaker->get() instanceof Leaf79C), '|';
$stop = null;
$f = new Fiber(function () use (&$g, &$stop) {
    try {
        $g->current();
        echo 'BAD-RETURN|';
    } catch (Exception $e) {
        echo 'CAUGHT|', (int) ($e === $stop), '|';
    }
});
echo 'START|', (int) ($f->start() === 'park79'), '|';
$stop = new Exception('stop79');
echo 'THROW|';
$f->throw($stop);
echo 'CLOSED|', (int) ($g->current() === null), '|',
     (int) ($weakMaker->get() === null), '|';
unset($g, $f, $stop, $weakMaker);
echo 'E';

purpose: A real Closure factory has Mid lexical scope but unrelated Host called class/This, selects a Mid private BYREF Generator on a distinct Leaf receiver instead of Leaf public namesake, then retires its factory/capture/Host before body entry. Fresh SEND and supplied Fiber abort preserve the real callee receiver and shared reference cache independently.
source:
<?php
class Capture79 {}
class Payload79 { function __destruct() { echo 'TOKEN|'; } }
class Host79 { function __destruct() { echo 'HOST|'; } }
class Mid79 {
    private function &body(&$item) {
        global $weakTarget, $weakPayload;
        echo 'BODY|', (int)(__CLASS__ === 'Mid79'), '|',
            (int)(static::class === 'Leaf79'), '|', (int)($this === $weakTarget->get()), '|';
        try {
            Fiber::suspend('fresh79');
            $received = yield $item;
            Fiber::suspend('cached79');
            echo 'BAD-BODY|';
        } finally {
            echo 'FIN|', (int)($this === $weakTarget->get()), '|',
                (int)($received === 79), '|', (int)($item === $weakPayload->get()), '|';
        }
    }
    function __destruct() { echo 'TARGET|'; }
}
class Leaf79 extends Mid79 {
    public function &body(&$item) { echo 'BAD-LEAF|'; yield $item; }
}
function Run79() {
    global $g, $stop, $weakTarget, $weakPayload;
    try { echo 'CALL|'; $g->send(79); echo 'BAD-RETURN|'; }
    catch (Exception $e) {
        echo 'OUT|', (int)($e === $stop), '|', (int)($e->getPrevious() === null), '|',
            (int)($weakTarget->get() === null), '|', (int)($weakPayload->get() instanceof Payload79), '|';
    }
    return 'fiber79';
}
$item = new Payload79();
$old =& $item;
$weakPayload = WeakReference::create($item);
$capture = new Capture79();
$weakCapture = WeakReference::create($capture);
$host = new Host79();
$target = new Leaf79();
$weakHost = WeakReference::create($host);
$weakTarget = WeakReference::create($target);
$template = function ($receiver, &$slot) use ($capture) {
    global $weakHost;
    echo 'FACTORY|', (int)(get_called_class() === 'Host79'), '|',
        (int)($this === $weakHost->get()), '|';
    return $receiver->body($slot);
};
$factory = $template->bindTo($host, 'Mid79');
$weakFactory = WeakReference::create($factory);
$g = $factory($target, $item);
unset($capture, $template, $factory, $host, $target, $item);
$item = 9;
echo 'FRESH|', (int)($weakFactory->get() === null), '|',
    (int)($weakHost->get() === null), '|', (int)($weakCapture->get() === null), '|',
    (int)($weakTarget->get() instanceof Leaf79), '|';
$f = new Fiber('Run79');
echo 'START|', (int)($f->start() === 'fresh79'), '|';
unset($old);
echo 'RESUME|', (int)($f->resume() === 'cached79'), '|';
echo 'CACHE|', (int)($g->current() === $weakPayload->get()), '|', (int)($item === 9), '|';
$stop = new Exception('stop79');
echo 'ABORT|';
$f->throw($stop);
echo 'CLOSED|', (int)($g->current() === null), '|',
    (int)($weakPayload->get() instanceof Payload79), '|', (int)($f->getReturn() === 'fiber79'), '|';
unset($g);
echo 'DROP|', (int)($weakPayload->get() === null), '|E';
